import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["readings"].copy()

    # Row-level bad rule
    df["is_bad"] = df["value"].isna() | (df["value"] < 0) | (df["value"] > 1000)

    # Batch-level aggregates
    grp = df.groupby("batch_id")
    total_rows = grp["reading_id"].transform("count")
    bad_count = grp["is_bad"].transform("sum")

    reject_pct = bad_count * 100.0 / total_rows
    quarantine_mask = (bad_count * 100) > (total_rows * 20)

    # Quarantined batches: all rows (good and bad) go here
    quarantine_df = df[quarantine_mask].copy()
    quarantine_df["batch_reject_pct"] = reject_pct[quarantine_mask].round(2)
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df[
        ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value", "batch_reject_pct"]
    ]

    # Non-quarantined batches: split by row rule
    rest = df[~quarantine_mask]
    clean_df = rest[~rest["is_bad"]][["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]]
    rejects_df = rest[rest["is_bad"]][["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]]

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_rejects": rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
